examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
11
new
add 1 10
reserve 100 1 4
available 1
reserve 101 1 7
cancel 100
available 1
reserve 101 1 7
confirm 101
available 1
cancel 101
examples.expected: null null true 6 false true 10 true true 3 false
examples.display:
calls   = Inventory(), add(1, 10), reserve(100, 1, 4),
          available(1), reserve(101, 1, 7), cancel(100),
          available(1), reserve(101, 1, 7), confirm(101),
          available(1), cancel(101)
results = null, null, true, 6, false, true, 10, true, true, 3,
          false

Order 101 cannot get 7 units while order 100 holds 4 of the 10. After the confirm, 3 units are left and order 101 has no hold to cancel.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.input:
7
new
add 5 3
reserve 1 5 1
reserve 1 5 1
confirm 1
reserve 1 5 1
available 5
examples.expected: null null true false true true 1
examples.display:
calls   = Inventory(), add(5, 3), reserve(1, 5, 1),
          reserve(1, 5, 1), confirm(1), reserve(1, 5, 1),
          available(5)
results = null, null, true, false, true, true, 1

An order can hold only one thing at a time, but may reserve again after it is confirmed.

edge.label: Edge 1: an item that was never added
Edge 3: cancel and confirm with no hold
Edge 4: a failed reserve leaves no hold
